title: Refusal to Submit to Breath Test
grade_or_penalty: 1st: $300-$500, forfeiture until interlock installed. 2nd: $500-$1,000, 1-2 yr forfeiture + interlock. 3rd+: $1,000, 8 yr forfeiture + interlock. Second and later refusal forfeitures run consecutive to the DWI forfeiture.
key_points: Court must find, by a preponderance: probable cause the person drove or was in actual physical control on a public or quasi-public road while impaired (alcohol, drugs, or cannabis); that the person was arrested, if appropriate; and that the person refused when asked.
Implied consent itself is in N.J.S.A. 39:4-50.2; cite the correct section on the summons.
officer_notes: Read the AG standard statement exactly as written and document the response.
